poems.title: Between Two Brushstrokes
poems.excerpt: I spilled a drop of morning rose upon the virgin linen, and watched the silence turn into a song...
poems.fullText:
I spilled a drop of morning rose
upon the virgin linen,
and watched the silence turn into a song.

We are all fragments of unfinished canvases,
searching for the shade of terracotta
that feels like coming home.

Under the shade of ancient college trees,
we paint what words dare not confess,
and let the wet pigment hold our quiet breath.

poems.title: Verses in the Library Hall
poems.excerpt: Old leather bindings smell of rain and centuries of longing. I left a poem between pages forty and four...
poems.fullText:
Old leather bindings smell of rain
and centuries of longing.
I left a poem between pages forty and four,
hoping someone with paint-stained fingers
might find it when the monsoon arrives.

You do not simply read art;
you allow it to undress your guarded thoughts
and leave them luminous in the dark.

poems.title: The Anatomy of a Sunrise
poems.excerpt: Crimson first, then whisper-pink, then all the world is gold...
poems.fullText:
Crimson first, then whisper-pink,
then all the world is gold.

Every daybreak is a masterwork
no painter can ever own,
yet we spend our lives with wet palettes,
trying to capture just one heartbeat of its grace.

reviews.name: Tanya Malhotra
reviews.comment: Purchased 'Whispers of North Campus' and it sits proudly in my living room. The textures and blush earthy tones bring so much warmth and nostalgia. Akanksha is an exceptionally gifted artist!

reviews.name: Kavya Singhania
reviews.comment: Akanksha was the star of our cultural fest face painting arena! The queues were endless because her designs were literally wearable masterpieces. Highly professional and so charming.

reviews.name: Arjun Verma
reviews.comment: The hand-painted tote bag and poetry zine arrived in gorgeous blush packaging with a handwritten wax-sealed note. The care and artistic soul put into every single item is magical.

reviews.name: Simran Kohli
reviews.comment: Booked Akanksha for an editorial photoshoot. Her body painting & intricate eye motifs elevated our entire lookbook. Will definitely collaborate again!
